results.name: A counter downloads everything needed to count offline (blind: no expected quantities)
Counts made offline sync later with the phone's time; the same count sent twice is stored once
Each scan adds one (a box barcode adds 12); scans are not flagged as double entries
"Bin empty" records 0 for every uncounted item in the bin, once
A count made before counting closed but synced after is accepted as late and the comparison refreshed
A cycle count picks the most important items first (A class) and starts immediately
A full stocktake can run alongside a cycle count; the daily job makes one per warehouse on weekdays
My tasks shows the counter today's count with progress, tools held and unread messages
Staff can undo their own withdrawal within 10 minutes; stock is restored and the integrity check stays green
Undo is refused after the window, for other types and when switched off
A photo can be attached to a damage record by the person who made it; other warehouses cannot see it
Each person picks a language and text size; SA mobile numbers are normalised
Alerts go to WhatsApp only for people who opted in, when switched on, at their chosen severity
A training warehouse comes with practice bins and stock, clearly marked, and only setup managers can create it
The accounting journal balances (debits = credits) and matches stock value movements
The Monday summary e-mail goes once per person with report access, with rand values only for price viewers
Bins can be created in bulk in walking order (snake route), and the route can be changed
Anonymous callers can reach none of the new functions or tables
After all Phase 4 activity the integrity check finds no critical problems
